title: Dinner Lady Fruit Full Ultimate Strawberry 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Dinner Lady’s Fruit Full Ultimate Strawberry delivers a rich and satisfying take on one of the most beloved fruit flavours. Ripe, sun-kissed Strawberries take centre stage, offering a soft yet full-bodied sweetness with a naturally juicy character. Hints of tangy berry undertones add depth, creating a well-rounded and irresistibly smooth vape. As part of the Fruit Full Bar Salts collection, Ultimate Strawberry has been crafted to replicate the bold and concentrated flavours found in disposable vapes. The double-concentrated Nic Salt formula ensures a deep, long-lasting flavour while providing a consistently smooth vaping experience. Blended at 50VG/50PG, this e-liquid delivers an excellent balance of vapour production and flavour clarity. The nicotine salt formulation offers a smooth throat hit and rapid nicotine satisfaction, making it an ideal choice for use with low-powered MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape kits and starter devices. Since its launch in 2016, Dinner Lady has built a reputation as one of the UK’s most respected e-liquid brands, known for their commitment to quality and distinctive flavour combinations. Available in over 80 countries worldwide, Dinner Lady e-liquids are expertly blended using high-quality ingredients to ensure a premium vaping experience.
